subject: CloudForge & Redwood: compact demo circuit + webinar pairing — MDF workback
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudforge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Kim <leah.kim@cloudforge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: compact demo circuit + joint webinar (Nov-Jan)

Hi Kimberly,

Hope youre well. Quick note from the CloudForge events team — wed love to propose a compact demo circuit with Redwood as our primary co-sponsor. High level: three one-day pop-up demo events (San Francisco, Austin, Boston) across late Jan to early Feb, plus a single joint webinar in mid-December to prime pipeline.

Why this format: smaller footprint events reduce cost, but pair well with a webinar that drives accounts into the demos. Target audience: platform engineers and infra leads at mid-market SaaS companies, primarily west and east coast accounts. We estimate 80-120 qualified attendees per city, and 400-600 live webinar registrations.

Ask from Redwood: MDF to cover venue/exhibitor fees plus a shared paid acquisition budget for webinar promotion. Ballpark ask: 60k total MDF covering venue deposits and paid social. CloudForge will match with creative and paid channels. We also need alignment on booth staffing, demo topics, and a mutual action plan.

Attached: MDF_SOW_CloudForge.pdf and an initial agenda draft (agenda-draft.docx) to illustrate format.

Two quick questions to get started:
- Any Redwood constraints on MDF terms (timing, invoicing, blackout dates)?
- Preferred host/presenter list for the webinar from Redwood?

If this looks promising wed love to run a 30-minute sync with your events team this week.

Best,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
Sanjay@cloudforge.com

Attachments: MDF_SOW_CloudForge.pdf (pdf), agenda-draft.docx (docx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: compact demo circuit + joint webinar (Nov-Jan)

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks for the thoughtful proposal. This format aligns well with Redwood priorities for late Q1 demand gen. Quick takeaways and proposed next steps below. Im looping in Marcus for event budget/logistics and Tessa for on-the-ground staffing and operations.

What we can commit to now
- Redwood is prepared to commit to up to 45,000 USD in MDF conditional on a signed SOW and a simple mutual action plan.
- We can co-host the webinar and provide two Redwood presenters.

Information we need from CloudForge by Nov 18 to secure dates
- Top 50 target account list (company + ideal attendee role)
- Expected paid social creative (example ads) and landing page mockup
- Primary webinar date preference for Dec 10-17 window

Mutual action plan (draft)
- Nov 18: CloudForge delivers target list + creative assets
- Nov 20: Signed SOW and MDF form in DocuSign to reserve venue deposits
- Nov 24: Landing page live and registration open for webinar
- Dec 7: Final promo calendar and email copy signoff
- Jan 10-31: City pop-ups executed (SF, Austin, Boston order TBD)

Please take a look at the attached agenda-draft and add presenter names and 20-minute demo topics where appropriate. Marcus and Tessa, any immediate red flags on timing or the proposed funding cadence?

I can set a 30-minute sync tomorrow if Sanjay and Leah can make it.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Director, Partner Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: agenda-draft.docx (docx)

Hi all,

Quick logistics note from events ops. Nice idea on the compact demo circuit. I ran rough estimates and attached a staffing and cost sheet. Key assumptions and asks:

Booth & staffing
- Recommended booth footprint: 10x10 pop-up with tabletop monitor, quick demo area, and branded backdrop.
- Staffing: 2 dedicated reps per city (one technical demo lead, one AE for qualification). Travel/hotel per person estimated at 1,200 USD per city.

Budget split recommendation
- Venue/exhibitor fees per city: estimated 12k USD.
- Paid social for webinar: target 6k USD.
- Redwood proposes a 60/40 split on paid social and creative production (Redwood 60%).
- MDF ask clarified: 25k USD per city reserved for venue and local logistics, with CloudForge covering local promos and some onsite hospitality.

Timing risks
- Venue deposits for SF and Austin require signed paperwork by Nov 24 to secure negotiated rates.
- If DocuSign is not completed by Nov 20, we may need to adjust target dates or accept higher venue costs.

Action items for CloudForge
- Confirm the two presenter names for the webinar and one backup
- Provide headcount for each demo day (expected onsite staff + local guests)
- Confirm whether CloudForge can run the event registration page or wants Redwood to host via our marketing stack

I attached booth-staffing-sheet.xlsx with line item estimates. Once the SOW is signed we can produce a PO for the MDF and route to finance.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: booth-staffing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx)
